sections.title: MUSA Stats Bootcamp
sections.description: The goal of this course is to give students an introduction to basic probability and several widely used statistical tests. Topics covered will include probability, random variables, statistics and their distributions, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing, t-tests. Because students typically come from different academic backgrounds, it is expected that there will be a rather wide spectrum of mathematical knowledge and experience among class participants. To accommodate students who have not recently taken a class on algebra, precalculus or calculus, one of the first lectures will focus on reviewing basic mathematical concepts that would be necessary for this course and the courses they'll take in the fall. Finally - and perhaps most importantly - this course will aim to prepare students for the statistics courses they will take in the fall semester.
